description: This file implements a Timer plugin class for the WPEFramework, managing timers with start, cancel, suspend, resume, and status functionalities, including event notifications and external CEC commands.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A plugin class managing multiple timers, their states, and event notifications within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: checkTimers
methods.description: Checks and updates timers, manages timer expiration and reminders.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with a given ID.

methods.name: cancelTimer
methods.description: Cancels a timer with a given ID.

methods.name: suspendTimer
methods.description: Suspends a timer with a given ID.

methods.name: onTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer fires, handling expiration and repeating timers.

methods.name: getTimerStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a specified timer.

methods.name: startTimerWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for starting a timer via JSON parameters.

methods.name: cancelWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for canceling a timer via JSON parameters.

methods.name: suspendWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for suspending a timer via JSON parameters.

methods.name: resumeWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for resuming a suspended timer via JSON parameters.

methods.name: getTimerStatusWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving timer status via JSON parameters.

methods.name: getTimersWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving all timers' statuses.

methods.name: sendTimerExpired
methods.description: Sends notification and external CEC command when a timer expires.

methods.name: sendTimerExpiryReminder
methods.description: Sends reminder notification before timer expiration.
